---
title: "Network Meta-Analysis"
---

```{r}
source("R/nma_functions.R")
dat <- load_pairwise_data()
nm_random <- run_model(dat, model_type = "simple", effect_model = "random")
```

## Network plot

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=9}
netmeta::netgraph(
  nm_random,
  number.of.studies = TRUE,
  thickness = "number.of.studies",
  multiarm = TRUE,
  points = TRUE,
  cex.points = 4,
  cex = 0.8,
  plastic = FALSE,
  seq = sort(nm_random$trts)
)
```

## Model summary

```{r}
summary(nm_random, backtransf = TRUE)
```

## Forest plot

```{r fig.height=7, fig.width=9}
forest(nm_random, backtransf = TRUE)
```

## League table

```{r}
lt <- netmeta::netleague(nm_random, random = TRUE, common = FALSE, ci = TRUE,
                         backtransf = TRUE, bracket = "(", separator = " - ")
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(lt$random))
```
